tools.name: list_european_providers

tools.name: featured_listing_info
tools.description: Returns the price of an Infrabase.ai featured listing, the pages it appears on and what it does not change. Read-only.

tools.name: request_featured_listing
tools.description: Sends a featured-listing request for a product to Infrabase.ai. Call it only after the user has confirmed. It sends their email address to Infrabase; a person replies by email. Calling it charges nothing.
